title: CT canonical SDK version manifest (LINKAGE source for SCP-R-009)
description: Shape of control-tower's policies/canonical-sdk-versions.yaml as SCP-R-009 (auth-canonical-version-pin) reads it. LINKAGE-not-VALUES (D-049/D-058): SCP validates the SHAPE it depends on (the per-package canonical_version + minimum_secure_version it gates adopter pins against) and TOLERATES additional CT-authored fields (additionalProperties:true) — CT is the sole authority over the values + the package set. SCP never copies the version numbers into rule bodies; the rule reads them from input.canonical_sdk_versions at evaluation time (cosign/Ed25519-verified by the materialisation workflow). Verified against the live manifest 2026-06-06.

schema_version.description: CT manifest schema version (live value integer 1; string tolerated for forward-compat).

minimum_secure_version_floor.description: Estate-wide floor below which no package pin is ever blessed.

packages.description: Keyed by package name (e.g. ct-auth-ts, ct-auth-python, ct-auth-go). SCP-R-009 reads the ct-auth-* entries the adopter consumes.

auth_contract.description: Pointer + integrity hint for the sibling auth-contract-v1.yaml. The manifest_sha256 here is a freshness hint, NOT the verification anchor (the .sig.bundle cosign chain is — WP-SCP-028 plan §2.1).

canonical_version.description: Current canonical version; an adopter pin below this (but >= minimum_secure_version) is stale → SCP-R-009 warn.

minimum_secure_version.description: Lowest still-blessed version; an adopter pin strictly below this is a downgrade → SCP-R-009 deny.
